parsed.summary: The two Lean theorems state the variable-leaf parts of Theorems 1.2 and 1.3. For n ≥ 32, any tree-shaped formula over ℂ (+, −, ×; plus ÷ in the rational case, with every denominator nonzero) whose output is per_n has at least n^4/(128 log2 n) variable leaves, respectively n^4/(192 log2 n). The definitions match the paper's model, and the divisions by log are not affected by junk values. The main caveat is coverage: Theorem 1.1 (the circuit bound) and the gate-count and total-leaf bounds of Theorems 1.2/1.3 are not formalized.

glossary.plain: Binary expression tree whose leaves are variables x_i or constants c ∈ R, with internal nodes +, −, ×.
The polynomial in R[x_i] computed by the formula.
Number of leaves labelled by variables, counting repetitions; constant leaves count 0.
Arithmetic formula tree that also allows ÷ nodes.
Value in the fraction field R(x_i) of R[x_i]. Division by 0 would give 0 (junk), but this is excluded by Valid.
glossary.standard_concept: rational function computed by a formula

glossary.plain: Every ÷ node has a denominator subformula that evaluates to a nonzero element of the fraction field, applied recursively.
Number of variable-labelled leaves, counting repetitions.
per_n = Σ_σ Π_i x_{i,σ(i)} in ℂ[x_ij].

lean_claims.plain: For n ≥ 32 and any division-free formula f over ℂ in the variables x_ij with eval f = per_n: n^4/(128·log2 n) ≤ L_var(f).
For n ≥ 32 and any valid formula f with division over ℂ whose value in ℂ(x_ij) equals per_n: n^4/(192·log2 n) ≤ L_var(f).

paper_claims.plain: For n ≥ 32, a division-free formula Φ computing per_n satisfies L_var(Φ) ≥ n^4/(128 log2 n) and G(Φ) ≥ n^4/(256 log2 n); the leaf bound also holds for total leaves and total vertices.
For n ≥ 32, a valid formula with division computing per_n satisfies L_var(Φ) ≥ n^4/(192 log2 n) and G(Φ) ≥ n^4/(384 log2 n); the leaf bound also holds for total leaves and total vertices.

coverage.why: No circuit model or circuit-size bound appears in the file.
Only the L_var bound is stated. The G bound and the total-leaf/vertex bounds are omitted, though they follow easily since total leaves ≥ L_var.

flags.explanation: The headline circuit lower bound C(per_n) ≥ (n^2/144)(log2 log2 n − 3) is not formalized at all.

The gate-count bound G(Φ) ≥ n^4/(256 log2 n) and the total leaves/vertices versions are not stated. They are elementary consequences of the L_var bound, since a binary tree with L leaves has L−1 internal gates.
flags.probe_idea: Define a gate count and prove gates f + 1 = leaves f ≥ variableLeaves f, then derive the G bound.

flags.explanation: The gate-count bound G(Φ) ≥ n^4/(384 log2 n) and the total-leaf/vertex versions are omitted.
